topic: Decide which conference our lab should attend this year

scenario.topic: Decide which conference our lab should attend this year
scenario.opening_question: What matters most to us this year: networking, cost, or cutting-edge research?

options.name: International AI Symposium in Berlin
options.upside: Strong international networking and diverse research topics
options.tradeoff: Long travel time and high lodging costs
options.concern: Jet lag might reduce productivity during the conference
options.best_for: Maximizing global connections and exposure to varied AI research

options.name: Regional Machine Learning Workshop in Austin
options.upside: More hands-on sessions and lower travel fatigue
options.tradeoff: Smaller scale with fewer networking opportunities
options.concern: Less exposure to cutting-edge international research
options.best_for: Focused skill-building and minimizing travel stress

options.name: National Robotics Conference in Boston
options.upside: Strong industry presence and latest robotics demos
options.tradeoff: Higher cost and longer duration than some options
options.concern: May have less emphasis on AI research relevant to our lab
options.best_for: Connecting with industry partners and robotics innovation

options.name: Virtual Deep Learning Summit
options.upside: Lowest cost and access to many recorded talks for flexible viewing
options.tradeoff: Limited live interaction and networking opportunities
options.concern: Lower engagement and potential distractions at home
options.best_for: Budget-conscious teams prioritizing content over networking

shared_context: The lab has a budget cap of $6000 for conference expenses.
The team consists of exactly 3 participants attending together.
The goal is to maximize professional growth while staying within budget and time limits.

personas.background: Anton values strong international networking to broaden the lab's global connections despite potential travel fatigue.
personas.private_goal: He wants the lab to maximize exposure to diverse AI research and global collaborators.
